publication: Study, selection, attempt, protocol and dataset manifest are copied byte-for-byte. No market price CSV is redistributed. Descriptor paths are logical labels.
reproduction_notes: Re-download the pinned source locally. Normalized CSV SHA-256 should match the published manifest.
A new download changes retrieved_at_utc and therefore the manifest SHA-256; this is metadata, not a price change.
A fresh run has new timestamps and therefore new selection/study hashes. Check input/source hashes and numerical evidence separately.
The output-directory marker is a local rerun guard, not proof that an interval has never been inspected elsewhere.
